## XpmLiquidPackage.\_engine property

The Liquid engine used for substitutions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected _engine: Liquid;
```

## Remarks

This XpmLiquidEngine instance is configured with strict mode and custom filters for xpm-specific operations. It's shared across all actions and build configurations within the package, ensuring consistent template processing behavior.

Engine characteristics:

<ol> <li>Strict mode enabled to catch undefined variable references.</li> <li>Custom filters for platform detection (isPlatform, isArch).</li> <li>Custom filters for path sanitization (filterPath, filterPosixPath, filterWin32Path).</li> <li>Shared instance reduces memory overhead and ensures consistent template evaluation across all package components.</li> </ol>
